question: The 2010 Hockey World Cup final took place in which Indian city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **2010 Men's Hockey World Cup** was the **12th edition** of the flagship international field hockey tournament organized by the **International Hockey Federation (FIH)**.
 
• The entire tournament was held from **28 February to 13 March 2010** at the **Major Dhyan Chand National Stadium** located in **New Delhi**, India.
